title: Initials
description: initials prints the uppercase initials of a name.
criteria: US-001 Initials of a name: sh initials NAME prints the first letter of every word of NAME, in uppercase, with nothing between them

stack.instructions: POSIX sh and the standard utilities only. The tool is the script initials at the root of the repository, run as sh initials NAME.

planted.wrong: keeps each initial in the case it was written
planted.special_cased: prints AL for the example and the name unchanged otherwise
planted.partial: prints the initials of the first two words only
